scope: Read-only independent review of isolated pure source-best M lease component. No production owner/worker bridge or permit is accepted. No real GPU, production H_pipeline/native lock, existing PID or F was operated on.

independent_bounded_probes.method: Temporary directories only. _start/uuid4 exceptions were injected in-memory and temporary locks manually cleaned. A temporary owner/worker pair used a control pipe so the ignored-SIGTERM orphan could exit without signaling any existing PID. Four additional CPU children used mocked GPU inventories only; no nvidia-smi or CUDA calls were made.

findings.title: Owner metadata initialization exceptions leak an acquired phase descriptor
findings.impact: After successful flock, line52 assigns self.fd then calls _start and uuid.uuid4 before the cleanup try begins at line53. Either exception escapes __enter__ while the already-acquired phase FD remains open. Failed context entry will not invoke __exit__, so a supervisor that catches the error can keep the original phase locked indefinitely.
findings.evidence: Independent probes made _start and uuid4 raise separately. Both left phase.fd present and an independent descriptor blocked on the temporary H_pipeline.lock. Explicit temporary cleanup restored acquisition.
findings.fix: Put all post-open/post-flock initialization, metadata and check operations inside a single exception-cleanup boundary, closing and clearing fd for any failure. Add separate _start and uuid4 initialization-failure regressions that assert no retained FD and immediate independent reacquisition.

findings.title: Catchable or ignored SIGTERM defeats the promised parent-death cleanup
findings.impact: prctl(PDEATHSIG,SIGTERM) preserves the worker signal disposition. If SIGTERM is ignored or handled without exiting, owner death does not terminate the worker. The inherited phase descriptor, and a native GPU descriptor if already acquired, can remain held after the owner exits. The ordinary default-signal test does not cover this case.
findings.evidence: An isolated temporary worker ignored SIGTERM before verify_worker(...,arm_parent_death=True). Its direct owner exited0, but the worker remained alive and kept the temporary phase lock busy. It released only after an independent control-pipe exit request. No existing PID was controlled.
findings.fix: Use an unignorable parent-death termination policy such as SIGKILL for this new worker, while retaining the direct-parent/start-tick post-prctl race check. Add a regression with inherited/explicit SIGTERM ignore that observes true owner exit, worker termination and release of all temporary phase/native descriptors.

verified_strengths: The component uses the original H_pipeline.lock and gpu_locks/UUID.lock naming domains. The existing-original-flock contention and duplicate-supervisor/worker tests pass using temporary locks.

dirfd traversal, O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file/empty/single-link checks and inode comparisons reject tested symlink, nonempty and separately opened same-inode cases without truncation or unlinking.

The inherited worker path requires the exact proof schema, direct parent PID and start ticks, parent FD/canonical inode agreement, current kernel FLOCK attribution and successful same-description reflock. Existing forged-birth and owner-FD-loss cases reject.

Normal owner context exit closes without LOCK_UN. Existing inherited-FD test proves a surviving child retains the phase lock until its own descriptor closes, so the normal close path does not prematurely release the shared phase description.

native_gpu checks selected UUID membership and observed physical index0-3 before opening the native lock, checks mapping again under its exclusive lock, and rejects busy compute inventory or memory>=100MiB. Independent mocked indices4,5,6,7 all reject before native GPU lock creation.
The native GPU FD is covered by try/finally after opening, including contention/query/verification failures. The tested duplicate native worker is rejected while the first retains its lock.
test_coverage_boundary: The existing15 tests passed but omit the two demonstrated failure modes. They cover default parent-death behavior, not an ignored/handled SIGTERM disposition, and cover failed postlock check, not metadata initialization before that check.
integration_boundaries: This generic lease is not a source-best selection permit, GPU execution approval, scientific gate or job-authentication layer. The future owner/worker bridge must independently bind its approved code, permit, configuration, model selection, native UUID and job identity.
Busy/memory inventory observations supplement cooperative kernel locks. This review does not prove atomic exclusion against unrelated launchers that ignore the shared phase/native lock protocol.
Canonical named locks must remain stable; this review did not inject unrestricted hostile unlink/rename operations against directories or shared live lock names.
